records.label: definitive_change_of_control_announcement
records.review_notes: The companies announce a definitive cash agreement for Nasdaq PAND at $60 per share. Merck will tender for the entire outstanding share capital, then merge its subsidiary into Pandion and pay the same price for remaining shares. Source-reviewed by Codex; not independently adjudicated by a human. Date is the sourced definitive-announcement calendar date; intraday publication time and exhaustive earliest-publication search were not established. Status is pending as described at announcement, not a present-day deal-status claim. Control percent means proposed post-transaction ownership, not acceptance threshold or the incremental stake purchased. Announcement evidence is a label only, never a pre-event feature.
records.review_scope: Definitive whole-company acquisition public announcement, jointly checked against complete disclosed merger chronology. Date-only precision retained; no exhaustive independent first-news search.
